```{r}
data <- read_csv('data/viral/metadata/SARS2_BA1_SPIKE_Dadonaite.csv')
data
```



```{r}
# Example data
#data <- tibble(mutant = c("N310T", "A45*", "G12D"))

# Function to split the mutation string
split_mut_sit <- function(mutation) {
  matches <- str_match(mutation, "([A-Za-z])(\\d+)(\\S)")
  if (!is.na(matches[1,1])) {
    return(matches[1, 2:4])
  } else {
    return(rep(NA, 3))
  }
}

# Apply the function and bind the result
data <- data %>%
  mutate(res = map(mutant, split_mut_sit)) %>%
  mutate(wt = map_chr(res, 1),
         site = as.integer(map_chr(res, 2)),
         mut = map_chr(res, 3)) %>%
  select(-res)

data
```



```{r}
model <- lm(target ~ site, data = data)
summary(model)
```
